# Execute only after root explicitly transfers the shared target back to C2.
# This retries the failed fourth step; it does not erase the original failure.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskRoot = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/ci-edit-loop-windows'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $taskRoot
$expectedHead = '4b13b64a0f4556470cbf6b7a5e1c7f1b000d0f50'
$expectedTree = '1e76097a22d620a9f3839ff0c0d49f1f3d636d68'
$actualHead = git rev-parse HEAD
$actualTree = git write-tree
if ($actualHead -ne $expectedHead -or $actualTree -ne $expectedTree) { throw 'Retry input identity changed' }
if (@(git diff --name-only).Count -ne 0) { throw 'Unstaged inputs appeared' }
if (Test-Path Env:RUST_TEST_THREADS) { throw 'Unexpected test concurrency override' }
if (Test-Path Env:QUANTICK_DRAWING_INSPECTOR) { throw 'Unexpected inspector override' }
$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = 'C:/src/quantick-worktrees/fix-mutation-retry-truth/target'
$env:CARGO_BUILD_JOBS = '1'
$env:CARGO_TERM_COLOR = 'never'
$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES = "$taskRoot/crates/app/config/bubbles.toml"
$bubblesHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES).Hash
$lockHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath Cargo.lock).Hash
if ($bubblesHash -ne '5DB6B44A4564F7E0CD26482A3F1BADD17EB41788E6959453330F2738BB37CD4D') { throw 'Committed bubbles fixture changed' }
if ($lockHash -ne '8826F73F0589B91F318C40316C18C1925B926BD7A03C0DDB393CA0A84EC795FA') { throw 'Cargo lock changed' }
'STEP=4/4 retry after same-input diagnostic; earlier failure retained'
"START_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
"WRAPPER_PID=$PID"
"HEAD=$actualHead"
"INDEX_TREE=$actualTree"
"CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
"CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=$env:CARGO_BUILD_JOBS"
"QUANTICK_BUBBLES=$env:QUANTICK_BUBBLES"
"BUBBLES_SHA256=$bubblesHash"
"CARGO_LOCK_SHA256=$lockHash"
"TOOLCHAIN_FILE_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath rust-toolchain.toml).Hash)"
cargo --version
rustc --version
'COMMAND=cargo test --workspace'
& cargo test --workspace
$testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
"TEST_EXIT_CODE=$testExit"
"END_UTC=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
exit $testExit
